# 安全问题反馈

安全修复优先面向最新正式版本。报告问题前，请确认插件与相关漫画源的版本。

疑似漏洞请通过 [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/UFOAlastor/koreader_PicaYomi/security/advisories/new) 私下提交。普通使用问题请到 [Issues](https://github.com/UFOAlastor/koreader_PicaYomi/issues)。

请说明受影响版本、触发条件、影响范围和可复现步骤，尽可能使用测试数据。不要在公开 Issue、PR 或附件中提交密码、Cookie、token、私钥或个人阅读记录；私下报告也只提交复现所需的脱敏信息。

## English

Security fixes prioritize the latest stable release. Please [report vulnerabilities privately](https://github.com/UFOAlastor/koreader_PicaYomi/security/advisories/new), including affected plugin/source versions, impact, and sanitized reproduction steps. Use test data and omit credentials and personal information. General support requests belong in [Issues](https://github.com/UFOAlastor/koreader_PicaYomi/issues).
